Per-chain realised money-weighted NET P&L after all fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, rent effects and failed-attempt costs.
Signal-to-detection, quote, simulation, submission, inclusion and reconciliation timestamps joined per attempted trade.

Before any promotion: at least the proposal-specific minimum observations, positive money-weighted NET P&L and profit factor above 1 after all costs, acceptable tail loss under unchanged safeguards, at least 95% outcome attribution, and zero unresolved reconciliation failures.

proposals.downside_risk: Confirmed sample counts will fall and apparent performance may deteriorate; that is preferable to unsupported profitability.

evidence.detail: BROADCAST is included among executed statuses.
Missing realised_net_base falls back to expected_net_base, allowing forecast economics to enter LIVE performance windows.

proposals.expected_effect: SHADOW validation would quantify the difference between submitted, confirmed, reconciled and fully costed results, producing honest money-weighted strategy evidence.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 reconciled round trips per materially traded EVM chain, at least 30 calendar days, and explicit coverage counts for broadcasts, reverts, dropped transactions and failed-attempt gas.
proposals.rationale: A broadcast is not a confirmed, reconciled economic outcome, and expected profit is not realised profit. Mixing either into LIVE windows can overstate net P&L and misclassify execution failures as strategy outcomes.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay EVM execution records without submitting transactions. Count a completed outcome only after receipt success, final balance reconciliation and allocation of gas, builder fees, slippage, price impact and any failed-attempt gas. Compare legacy versus strict net P&L. Fail the hypothesis if any BROADCAST/unreconciled row enters realised P&L or if expected_net_base is used as an outcome.

proposals.downside_risk: Strict executable-edge evidence may reject most signals and reduce trade frequency.

evidence.detail: Entry economics estimate entry and exit gas relative to copied notional.
Expected edge is a weighted historical leader return, not a contemporaneous executable entry-and-exit quote.
The separate Strategy Lab EVM adapter can represent exact quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability, fees, slippage, price impact and latency reserve.

proposals.expected_effect: Identify chains, leaders, sizes and latency regimes where follower-realised NET P&L remains positive rather than merely inheriting leader history.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 eligible signals and 100 completed shadow round trips per chain across at least 30 days, with separate Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BSC and Polygon reporting and at least 95% outcome attribution.
proposals.rationale: A historically profitable leader can cease to offer positive follower edge after detection delay, copied-size impact, gas and exit costs. Chain-specific EVM economics also differ materially between Ethereum and lower-fee chains.
proposals.shadow_test: For every leader BUY, timestamp detection and obtain size-matched entry plus conservative executable exit quotes without trading. Reserve actual chain gas, builder fees, price impact, slippage and observed quote decay; separately label RPC/quote failures as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE. The hypothesis passes only if out-of-sample, money-weighted reconciled net P&L is positive after all realised costs. Stop if any chain has negative net P&L, profit factor at or below 1, or unresolved execution-failure attribution.

proposals.downside_risk: Most leader signals may remain ineligible; conservative exit quoting can understate recoverable value in volatile markets.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events explicitly retain zero current edge, liquidity and sellability because no contemporaneous executable future-return evidence exists.
The common SHADOW gate requires positive net edge, liquidity, sellability and quote freshness.
The execution fee cap derives partly from a configured expected-profit margin rather than signal-specific executable edge.
Route validation does separately constrain quoted price impact plus slippage and route complexity.

proposals.expected_effect: Create falsifiable Solana evidence without inventing profit, while separating market reversal from Jupiter/RPC/simulation/confirmation failures.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 300 signals, 150 completed shadow round trips, 30 days spanning multiple volatility/liquidity regimes, and at least five observations for each reported execution-failure class.
proposals.rationale: Solana architecture honestly abstains in Strategy Lab, but there is no demonstrated signal-specific executable edge covering round-trip Jupiter economics, priority fees, account rent effects, price impact, copy delay and failed attempts.
proposals.shadow_test: At leader-event receipt, capture a size-matched Jupiter entry quote and conservative executable exit quote, including platform/network/priority fees, non-reclaimed rent, slippage, price impact and measured quote decay. Follow the asset to the strategy exit and compute money-weighted net P&L. Classify a reconciled negative round trip as STRATEGY/MARKET; classify API, RPC, simulation, dropped transaction, balance-reconciliation or excessive quote-deterioration incidents as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE. Stop if net P&L is non-positive, profit factor is at or below 1, tail loss breaches existing limits, or attribution coverage falls below 95%.

proposals.downside_risk: Causal categories can remain ambiguous without complete timestamps, quotes, receipts and balance deltas.

evidence.detail: The monitoring model defines distinct STRATEGY, MARKET, EXECUTION and INFRASTRUCTURE classifications.
Execution failures generate a separate finding and request engineering root-cause separation.
Solana loss reporting aggregates realised results and exit reasons but does not itself provide complete causal attribution for every trade.

proposals.expected_effect: Produce per-attempt attribution and counterfactual strategy P&L excluding infrastructure failures, alongside actual wallet P&L including every paid failure cost.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 attempts on each chain family, 30 days, at least 95% classified attempts, and exact reconciliation of aggregate attributed P&L to aggregate wallet P&L within documented rounding tolerance.
proposals.rationale: Strategy thresholds should not be changed in response to RPC, quote, simulation, inclusion or reconciliation failures, while confirmed adverse market outcomes must not be excused as infrastructure.
proposals.shadow_test: Join each signal, quote, simulation, submission, receipt and reconciled wallet delta. Require exactly one primary cause plus optional contributing causes. Actual NET P&L must include all failure costs; strategy-only diagnostics may exclude independently proven infrastructure failures but must remain separately labelled. Fail if more than 5% of attempts are UNKNOWN or if totals do not reconcile to wallet deltas.

rejected_ideas.reason: Win count does not establish positive expectancy after loss magnitude and chain-specific execution costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat quote simulation, BROADCAST status or expected profit as realised promotion evidence.
rejected_ideas.reason: None proves confirmed execution or wallet-reconciled net proceeds.

rejected_ideas.idea: Pool Solana and EVM outcomes into one profitability claim.
rejected_ideas.reason: Their fee markets, route mechanics, failure modes and latency economics require chain-specific evaluation.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The common SHADOW evaluators correctly require positive cost-adjusted edge and fail Solana observations closed when current executable edge is unavailable. However, production leader-copy admission remains substantially historical rather than contemporaneously executable, Solana fee budgeting uses a configured expected-profit margin, and EVM Strategy Lab accounting can treat BROADCAST or expected P&L as realised performance. These issues can confound durable money-weighted NET P&L assessment. STRATEGY/MARKET loss means a confirmed, reconciled round trip executed as intended but produced negative net P&L after all costs. EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure means rejection, revert, dropped or unreconciled broadcast, material quote-to-fill deterioration, stale detection, RPC/API failure, or missing balance reconciliation. No fresh runtime forensics exist, so profitability and CANARY/LIVE readiness are not established.
